title: Relaxed Blog Creator
description: A simple and beautiful blog webpage that allows users to create posts with titles, descriptions, and images. Users can also comment on blog posts to engage with the content.

features.name: Create Blog Posts
features.description: Users can create blog posts by adding a title, description, and uploading images.

features.name: Image Upload
features.description: Users can upload images to include in their blog posts, enhancing the visual appeal of the content.

features.name: Commenting System
features.description: Users can leave comments on blog posts to interact and share their thoughts.

features.name: Bright and Relaxed Design
features.description: The webpage will feature a bright, beautiful, and relaxed design to provide a pleasant user experience.

constraints: No user authentication or roles are required.
No specific technology or framework is mandated.
No hosting or deployment requirements are specified.
target_users: General users who want a simple platform to create and share blog posts.
data_requirements: Each blog post should store a title, description, and associated images. Comments should be linked to their respective blog posts.
